about: The Chronicle theme sheet of the Chronicle of Aoaz window (spec 04 section 8, design system section 1.4; UI overhaul lane W9), in the format of tools/content/data/ui/zin_chrome.json so lib/zin_chrome.mjs cuts it: rows of pieces separated by black gutters. Painted by gpt-6-luna (tools/content/art/chronicle-jobs.mjs); modules/chronicle.mjs cuts and fits it. Frame order normal, hover, pressed (design system 6.2).

sheet.alphaNote: Cells whose alpha comes from their outline on the black ground: the open plate frame (its centre is black and becomes transparent), the arrows, the unread mark and the sigils.

themes.chronicle: Chronicle: carved blue-grey slate (#2D353A) with an inlaid bronze line (#78664C, lit #CAB289) and small diamond studs; pale vellum (#E2D1B5) for reading leaves; rubric red cloth (#5C1714) with a tooth-cut edge for the title band and the selected state

items.subject: a square recessed slate well: a plain, calm, even dark blue-grey slate floor sunk below a thin inlaid bronze rim, with a tiny bronze diamond stud at each corner; the floor has no pattern

a square vellum reading leaf: plain pale cream vellum, very calm and even, with a thin inlaid bronze rule all round about one twentieth of the width in from the edge and a small bronze diamond at each corner; nothing written on it
an open rectangular frame about two and a half times as wide as tall: a narrow bronze-inlaid slate moulding with small diamond studs at the corners; its whole inside is empty pure black
a long horizontal rubric-red cloth band about nine times as wide as tall, calm and even, with a thin bronze edge line along top and bottom and short tooth-cut ends at left and right
a long flat slate button plate about six times as wide as tall, plain calm dark slate face, thin bronze rim
the same slate button plate, its face slightly lighter and its bronze rim brighter (hover)
the same slate button plate, its face slightly darker with a faint inner shadow along the top (pressed)
the same button plate in rubric red cloth with a bright bronze rim (selected)
a long thin flat slate row strip about eight and a half times as wide as tall, plain calm face slightly lighter than the slate, hairline bronze edge
the same row strip, slightly lighter, its edge brighter (hover)
the same row strip, slightly darker with a faint inner shadow (pressed)
the same row strip in deep rubric red with a bright bronze edge line (selected)
a long thin flat button about nine times as wide as tall in pale vellum with a thin bronze rim
the same vellum button slightly brighter, its rim brighter (hover)
the same vellum button slightly darker with a faint inner shadow (pressed)
a short flat slate plaque about three times as wide as tall, plain calm face, bronze rim with tiny diamond studs at its ends
the same short plaque, slightly lighter, rim brighter (hover)
the same short plaque, slightly darker with a faint inner shadow (pressed)
a small bronze arrowhead pointing left inside a small round slate stud
the same left arrow stud, brighter bronze (hover)
the same left arrow stud, darker (pressed)
a small bronze arrowhead pointing right inside a small round slate stud
the same right arrow stud, brighter bronze (hover)
the same right arrow stud, darker (pressed)
a tiny bright red-gold enamel diamond, the mark of an unread page
an ink-engraved sigil on a small vellum roundel in a slate bezel: a ring of seven faint stars
the same kind of sigil roundel: a broken stone arch half sunk in water
the same kind of sigil roundel: an upright spear with a long pennant
the same kind of sigil roundel: a cracked bell
the same kind of sigil roundel: a pale lantern on a short chain
the same kind of sigil roundel: a slender tower on the shore of still water
the same kind of sigil roundel: five banners converging on one point
the same kind of sigil roundel: a quill crossed over an open book
the same kind of sigil roundel: a circle of four joined hands
the same kind of sigil roundel: a compass rose with no letters
the same kind of sigil roundel: a small shield on a tree with deep roots
the same kind of sigil roundel: a wax seal on a ribbon
the same kind of sigil roundel: a faceted crystal

sprites.note: Each sprite: its texture under gfx/interface/zin/chronicle/, the size of one frame, the fit and the cells in frame order (normal, hover, pressed). nine_slice cells keep their painted rim: cellBorder is the painted border as a fraction of the cell height, border the target border in pixels.
